interface.description: Network interface to monitor (e.g., eth0, enp0s3). Must support promiscuous mode.

pcap_file.description: Optional path to a PCAP file to analyze instead of capturing live traffic (useful for offline analysis).

log_file.description: Path to the log file where activity records are written.

email.description: Email address to receive alerts about new or changed ARP activity (e.g., new stations, MAC changes).

email_from.description: Sender email address used in alerts.

smtp_server.description: SMTP server hostname or IP for sending alert emails.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging (adds extra details to log entries).

daemon.description: Run arpwatch in daemon mode (background service).

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file used for managing the daemon process.

items.description: Additional command-line argument (e.g., '-f /usr/share/arpwatch/ethercodes.dat' to include vendor OUI data).

extra_args.description: List of extra arguments passed directly to the arpwatch command.

idle_threshold.description: If nonzero, send an alert when a station has been idle (no activity) for more than this many seconds.

report_new_only.description: If enabled, send alerts only for *new* stations, not updates for known stations (reduces noise).
